auditor: Two external auditors — one appointed by the Central Auditing Organization, one appointed by the Board of Directors upon nomination by the Audit Committee
detail: Article 36 of Egypt's Central Bank and Banking Sector Law No. 194 of 2020 states the Bank's accounts shall be audited by two external auditors drawn from the registered auditors, one appointed by the Central Auditing Organization and the other by the Board upon the Audit Committee's nomination, with fees agreed between the Bank and the Central Auditing Organization, and these audits substitute for the Central Auditing Organization's own audits; the law does not name the firms.
source_title: Banking Law No. 194 of 2020 (English translation, Andersen Egypt)

Section 47 of Republic Act No. 7653 (The New Central Bank Act), Article VII "The Auditor", states that the Chairman of the Commission on Audit shall act as the ex officio auditor of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas and may appoint a representative to serve as the Bangko Sentral's auditor.
